passages.question: Who belongs in 4904 Clerical Office?
passages.excerpt: 4904-00 Clerical office, N.O.C. Clerical office employees whose job duties and work environment meet all the conditions of the general reporting rules covering clerical office standard exception employees ... Care must be taken to look beyond job titles ... Work environment is restricted to a business office, meeting room, or similar office-like environment that is: Physically separated by walls, partitions, or other physical barriers from all other work areas ... Classification 4904 permits limited and minimal work outside an office for: Attending meetings; Banking; Purchasing supplies for the office; Taking correspondence to or from the post office; Taking training courses.
